Additionally, I'd like to remind you that our discussion today includes certain non-GAAP measures, which exclude stock-based compensation and certain other expenses. Our non-GAAP financials exclude certain expenses, gains or losses, and other items that are not expected to result in future cash payments or are non-recurring in nature or are not indicative of our core operating results and outlook. Please refer to our press release for more information about our non-GAAP measures.
Following management prepared remarks, we open the lines for a brief Q&A session. With this, I would like to turn the call over to our CEO, Gaofei Wang.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp

[Foreign language]
[Translator 1]
Translator 1
On the user front, in June 2025, Weibo's MAU reached 588 million, and average DAUs reached 261 million.
In Q2, Weibo's total revenues reached $444.8 million, up 2% year-over-year. Our total ad revenues reached $383.4 million, up 2% year-over-year. Our non-GAAP operating income reached $161.8 million, representing a non-GAAP operating margin of 36%.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]
[Translator 1]
Translator 1
In 2025, the company's overall strategy focuses on the value of users sustaining the leading position in trending topics and entertainment sectors, and solidifying the competitive edge of the social products. On top of that, we prioritize on enhancing the recommendation and search functions by integrating large language models to drive user scale and engagement. Let me share with you our progress made in Q2 2025 from three dimensions: user growth, the competitiveness of content ecosystem, and monetization.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language]
[Translator 1]
Translator 1
On user growth and engagement, we focus on integration of social product and upgrade of our recommendation system this year, aiming to drive user engagement and user growth. Over Weibo's 15 years development, the homepage information feed have continuously evolved to achieve two core objectives: to enhance the efficiency of content consumption and social interaction by users. Accordingly, the content recommendation mechanism of information feeds has evolved from a timeline-based distribution to a recommendation-based distribution. To be specific, the information feeds were originally distributed in reverse chronological order based on the posting time. As content creation became more convenient for users, the explosive amount of content produced largely exceeded the amount of content consumed. Therefore, to improve content consumption efficiency, we upgraded the algorithm of information feeds from purely timeline-based to focusing on distributing unread posts from individual accounts being followed by users in 2016.
Later in 2018, we introduced a new feed product structure composing of a relationship-based feed and an interest-based feed, aiming to broaden users content discovery and increase their content consumption scale.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language]
[Translator 1]
Translator 1
In recent years, users content consumption behaviors have been altered by the recommended content. To adapt to this trend, we initiated a strategic revamp of our homepage information feed in the H1 of this year, which makes the interest-based feed as the primary interface when user access Weibo.
We also make significant adjustments on the distribution mechanism of the interest-based feed. On the one hand, we integrated the recommendation mechanism for both relationship-based feed and interest-based feed. On the other hand, we enhance the user feedback mechanism based on users' interaction and consumption behaviors in the interest-based feed, aiming to meet their in-depth consumption demands. Overall speaking, while preserving users' fundamental need for social content consumption, the upgraded interest-based feed delivers improved efficiency of discovering interest-based content and deepens user engagement. Additionally, by leveraging large language models, we have enhanced the quality of recommended content, improving users' overall consumption experience.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]
[Foreign language].
[Translator 1]

In early July, we completed the upgrade of product and technical frameworks, which has rolled out to nearly all users. Currently, with the average content views of homepage information feed per user remaining stable, the proportion of the recommended content consumed by users has increased to 43%, representing a 17% improvement over the previous level. This establishes a solid foundation for efficiency improvement and the development of the platform's content ecosystem.

CEO, Weibo Corp

In the Q2, we further strengthened users' social interaction experience in the core product scenarios, achieving notable progress. For example, to address the prevalent issue of low quality content in commentary session, particularly comments and posts by celebrities and top KOLs, we enhanced the identification and monitoring of low quality content. This effectively improved discussion quality and increased users' willingness to visit and engage in the commentary session.
For the celebrity related Super Topics, we prioritize users genuine communication, content sharing, and consumption needs, and focus on improving the diversity of content and real-time attributes of the community. These efforts help improve social connection in celebrity related Super Topics, driving notable year-over-year growth of users who posted, engaged, and consumed content in the Q2.

Currently, over 50% of the interest-based content from key verticals are generated from cross-vertical KOLs, which benefit from our years of deep cultivation in vertical areas and the advantages of our vertical content operation. In Q2, vertical content consumption accounted for 60% of the interest-based feed consumption. Meanwhile, the new interest-based feed optimized content quality by allocating more traffic to high-quality, authentic content. This has increased the traffic share for KOLs and celebrity accounts, while also providing more growth opportunities for mid-tier and long-tail KOLs.
In the H2 of this year, with the goal of enhancing user engagement through the interest-based feed, we will increase the supply of quality content to users through product operations and recommend more precise and engaging content to users through recommendation. This will improve the efficiency for users to access effective content and their satisfaction of content consumption, and thereby further drive up content consumption and more frequent usage. While solidifying Weibo's advantages in entertainment verticals and trending topics, will support this long-term development of vertical content ecosystem to achieve a win-win situation where users enjoy quality content, creators develop, and the platform thrives.

As a result, Weibo Intelligent Search saw robust growth during this quarter, with MAUs surpassing 50 million in June. Notably, Weibo Intelligent Search has significantly enhanced the user experience for trending topics, as well as better fulfilled user queries in on-demand search scenarios. Daily active users of Intelligent Search also increased notably quarter-over-quarter, driving solid growth in average daily search queries.

Weibo's advertising and marketing revenues for Q1 2025 were $339.1 million flat, or an increase of 1% on a constant currency basis. Value-added service revenue was $57.7 million in Q1, an increase of 2% or 3% on constant currency basis. In line with our expectations, our advertising business continued to stabilize with diverging trends across our major ad vertical this quarter.
By industry, our largest three verticals were FMCG, e-commerce, and 3C products. In terms of growth, e-commerce, internet services, and automobile were the key contributors. E-commerce platform, Alibaba in particular, ramped up ad spend to amplify the Spring Festival marketing effect and capture surging consumer demand during the holiday season. We are also pleased with the healthy growth of the automobile sector, benefiting from the ongoing secular shift to electronic vehicles.
FMCG as a whole decreased by low single digits year-over-year this quarter. Within the category, dairy, food, and beverage products demonstrated a upward trend, while beauty and personal care continued to face a year-over-year gap, the segment showed a clear sequential recovery. On the other hand, the online game sector faced headwind and declined sharply due to lack of blockbuster release this quarter.
The handset manufacturers moderated their ad spend with us this quarter, mainly due to seasonal slowdown in the product launch pace of mid-to high-end handset devices. These underperforming industries without a meaningful top-line recovery. By ad product, promoted feed ad was the largest, followed by social display, and topic, and search. Ad revenues from Alibaba booked a robust growth of 89%, reaching $42.6 million in Q1.
The strong momentum of ad revenues from Alibaba was primarily driven by its high-profile sponsorship of the Spring Festival Gala to promote its platform and e-commerce events, as well as incremental ad spend in promoting their AI-related products. Value-added service revenue was $57.7 million in Q1, up 2% year-over-year, primarily driven by growth in membership services.
The increase in membership revenue was largely fueled by higher ARPU, as our SVIP membership, offering resonance well with Weibo's premium user base. Turning to costs and expenses. Total costs and expenses for Q1 were $267.4 million, a decrease of 1%, with decrease in sales and marketing expenses offset by increase in cost of revenues.
Operating income in Q1 was $179.5 million, an increase of 3%, representing operating margin of 33% compared to 32% in the same period last year. Turning to income tax under GAAP. Income tax expenses for Q1 were $24.3 million, compared to $25 million last year. Net income attributable to Weibo in Q1 was $119.5 million, an increase of 12%, representing a net margin of 30% compared to 27% last year. The increase was primarily attributable to operating efficiency and higher net interest and other income. Turning to our balance sheet and cash flow items as of 31 March 2025.
Weibo's cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $2.08 billion, compared to $2.35 billion as of 31 December 2024. The decrease of Weibo's cash equivalents, and short-term investments was mainly resulted from the purchase of long-term wealth management products in Q1 2025. In Q1, cash provided by operating activities was $113.2 million.
Capital expenditures totaled $9.4 million, and depreciation and amortization expenses amounted to $13.6 million. Before turning to the Q&A session, we are pleased to announce that we have completed the distribution of the annual cash dividends of $0.82 per ordinary share, or ADS, for the fiscal year 2024, with aggregate amount approximately $200 million in May. In addition.
We would like to provide an update on our ESG initiative. In April, we released our first ESG report highlighting our performance across key areas including green operations, employee development, content ecosystem, social responsibility, information security and technological innovation. The report underscores our long-term commitment to sustainability. For more information on our ESG disclosures, please visit our investor relations website. With that, let me now turn the call over to the operator for the Q&A session.
Operator
Thank you. As a reminder, to ask a question, you will need to press star one one on your telephone and wait for your name to be announced. To withdraw your question, please press star one one again. We will take our first question. The question comes from the line of Alicia Yap from Citigroup. Please go ahead. Your line is open.

Hello, thank you. [Foreign language] Thanks, management, for taking my question.
I wanted to ask about overall how you think about your search progressions. Weibo has actually been doing quite well. If you [Foreign language] give us a little bit your future strategy or how you think about the product, would that still remain within the Weibo to help and engage user, or would that be actually potentially become a separate product down the road? Then second, on the AI monetization.
Just wondering how after integrating DeepSeek and all other large language model, how our advertising product, has improved in terms of the ad format or the eCPM, or even how advertisers are able to put more targeted ads. Any color from that would be helpful. Thank you.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language] Go ahead.
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you very much for this question. I think you have been asking two questions. The first one is about the AI search. Second one is about the relationship between AI and also the advertisements. The first question is that in Q1, as we have already stated that last year, based on the open source models, we've been already providing the preliminary model or the AI search to the users.
After the Spring Festival in China, we've been seeing the launch of DeepSeek. We've been integrating DeepSeek into our whole facility and do see a very good improvement of our final effectiveness. In March, we've been launching this particular DeepSeek-based AI search to the users and seen a very good boost of the number of MAUs.
For instance, in March, the number has been reaching over 30 million, and this number will be also growing in April as well. We believe that in the future, the number of DAUs and also the volume of query will be improving because of this result. Okay.
Gaofei Wang

[Foreign language]
[Translator]

Right. We've been using the intelligent search or [Foreign language] in this particular area. We've been seeing a lot of usage of the users.
In terms of the general purpose search, still there is a certain kind of improvement. This particular volume increasement was not as good as that from the news area. For instance, it is probably because of the natural positioning or the natural you know feature of Weibo, which is particularly focused on entertainment and news related topics.
But of course, in terms of the user consumption, we do see about 5% of the increase in terms of the per capita search volume increase, and it does improve a lot on the per capita query, as well as the user retention. You know, part of those contents are actually generated or directly quoted from Weibo's intelligent search results. In the future, probably we can see more results related to this. Also as for the AI, for the consumers or the 2C part of AI, we've been seeing that for intelligent search, for instance, in terms of the total structure of this particular product within Weibo, we are still at a very primitive and early stage. As for the second question, the relationship between AI and, to what extent can we have a better advertisement related revenue? Still, for the other indicators, we did have only a single-digit improvement only. In terms of the overall advertising revenue improvement, the facilitation and also the boosting the fact from the AI technology is still pretty limited. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]

Yeah. Thank you.

Thank you. We will take our next question. Your next question comes from the line of Thomas Chong from Jefferies. Please go ahead. Your line is open.
Thomas Chong
Regional Head of Internet & Media, Jefferies
[Foreign language] Thanks, management, for taking my question. My question is about our advertising. Can management comment about the Q2 ad spending sentiment and expectation as well as the outlook for different industry verticals. My second question is about the updates of our advertising products and strategies. Thank you.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp
[Foreign language]
Thomas Chong

The overall trend, I think that we've been already elucidated on this topic before. We are expecting a very good performance from the vertical of e-commerce as well in Q2. Okay.

Just now we have said that in Q2 we expect a very good performance from vertical of headset and automotive. This industry, I mean the vertical of the headset, will be rebounded to a better track of growth in Q2. Okay.
Gaofei Wang

Yeah. Also, last year for some of the challenge in the verticals, we did see a very good improvement in Q1 in terms of their overall revenue contribution on a quarter-over-quarter basis. Still, we do see a lot of stress around these areas. For some of the overseas brands, we had a decrease of the revenue from them, but still, this was offset by some of the domestic brands increase.
Another very challenging industry is the gaming industry. We are facing a lot of challenges still in the next quarter also. You can see that the budget allocated by Tencent and NetEase has been reduced. Especially, you could see that in the financial statement proposed by the NetEase in the recent times.
Of course, how to mitigate that impact. We are going to fully leverage the AI advertisements or the performance-based ad increase, and especially some of the internet-based app related ads to have an offset of the challenge from the gaming industry. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corp

In terms of our ad products. In the past two years of time, we did a very good job in terms of operation and also focus on this competitive advantage, especially while the brands are making the launches of the new products.
In the future, we are going to further seize the opportunities from the brand new product launch and those hot topics, for instance. This is the very core part of our competitive edge, and we are going to be consistent in doing so and increasing our investment into this. Overall speaking, we by doing this and focusing on the products of this kind, we are going to pretty much stabilize the demand and try to get most part of the budget from those brands. Okay.

By doing the AI ad and some of the other innovative technologies and products, we are able to increase the awareness among the users and our existing customers and try to get new ones into the whole pool so that the revenue from this part could be enhanced because of these efforts. Okay.

content.text:
Operator
Good day and thank you for standing by. Welcome to the Weibo's Q4 and fiscal year 2024 financial results. At this time, all participants are in a listen-only mode. After the speaker's presentation, there'll be a question and answer session. To ask a question during the session, you will need to press star one one on your telephone. You will then hear an automated message advising your hand is raised. To withdraw your question, please press star one one again. Please be advised that today's conference is now being recorded. I'd now like to hand the conference over to your first speaker today, Sandra Zhang, Investor Relations representative of Weibo Corporation. Please go ahead.
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
Thank you, operator, and welcome to Weibo's Q4 and Fiscal Year 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our Chief Executive Officer, Gaofei Wang, and our Chief Financial Officer, Fei Cao. This conference call is also being broadcast on the Internet and is available through Weibo's IR website. Before the management remarks, I would like to read you the safe harbor statement in connection with today's conference call. During today's conference call, we may make forward-looking statements that are not historical facts, including statements of our beliefs and expectations.
Forward-looking statements involve inherent risks and uncertainties. A number of important factors could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements. Weibo assumes no obligation to update the forward-looking statements in this conference call and elsewhere.
Further information regarding this and other risks is included in Weibo's annual report on Form 20-F and other filings with the SEC. All the information provided in this press release is as of the date hereof. Weibo assumes no obligation to update such information except as required under applicable law. Additionally, I would like to remind you that our discussion today includes certain non-GAAP measures, which exclude stock-based compensation and certain other expenses. We use non-GAAP financial measures to gain a better understanding of Weibo's comparative operating performance and future prospects.
Our non-GAAP financials exclude certain expenses, gains, or losses, and other items that are not expected to result in future cash payments or are non-recurring in nature or are not indicative of our core operating results and outlook. Please refer to our press release for more information about our non-GAAP measures.
Following management prepared remarks, we open the lines for a brief Q&A session. With this, I would like to turn the call over to our CEO, Gaofei Wang.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
大家好，欢迎大家参加微博四季度财报电话会议。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
Thank you. Hello everyone. Welcome to Weibo's Q4 and Full Year 2024 Earnings Conference Call.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
本次财报会我向大家重点介绍微博产品运营以及商业化方面的进展，同时对2024年的工作策略进行简要回顾，并向各位介绍下我们2025年公司的整体策略。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
On today's call, I will share with you highlights on Weibo's product and monetization, review the progress made in 2024, and elaborate our strategies for 2025.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
先介绍微博在四季度的财务表现。四季度，微博总营收达到了$4.568亿，年年下降1%，其中广告营收达到$3.859亿，年年下降4%，增值业务收入达到$7,100万，年增长18%。剔除汇率因素，四季度总营收年年基本持平，四季度公司调整后营业利润达到$1.302亿，调整后营业利润率为30%。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
Starting from our financial performance in the Q4. Our total revenue in the Q4 reached $456.8 million, a decrease of 1% year-over-year, which were relatively flat year-over-year on a constant currency basis. Our total ad revenue reached $385.9 million, a decrease of 4% year-over-year. Our value added service revenues reached $71 million, an increase of 18% year-over-year. Our non-GAAP operating income in the Q4 reached 106.36 million, representing a non-GAAP operating margin of 30%.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
2024年，微博总营收达到17.5亿美金，年年基本持平，其中广告营收达到15亿美金，年年下跌2%。广告营收的下降主要由于不同行业广告业务表现分化，增值业务收入达到2.56亿美金，年年增长13%，主要得益于会员业务的升级跟重构。剔除汇率因素，总营收年年增长1%，全年调整后营业利润达到5.841亿美金，调整后全年营业利润率为33%。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
For full year 2024, our total revenue reached $1.75 billion, relatively flat year-over-year, or an increase of 1% year-over-year on a constant currency basis. Our total ad revenue reached $1.5 billion, a decrease of 2% year-over-year. The decrease was mainly resulted from the variance of ad performance across different industries. Our value added service revenue reached $256 million, an increase of 13% year-over-year, benefiting from the upgrade and restructuring of our membership service. For full year 2024, our non-GAAP operating income reached $584.1 million, representing a non-GAAP operating margin of 33%.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
用户方面，截至四季度末，我们的月活用户达到5.9亿，日活用户达到2.6亿。接下来我向大家介绍一下四季度在产品运营和商业化方面的进展。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
In December, Weibo's MAU reached 590 million and average DAU reached 260 million. Next, let me share with you our progress made in product and monetization in Q4.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
在社交活跃方面，社交产品的产品工作在两方面展开。一方面，关系流延续2024年的工作策略，加强优质内容消费，促进垂直内容生态建设。同时，社交互动形式提升关系流的社交粘性。四季度，关系流的独立用户占比和活跃用户比例得到提升。另一方面，为了进一步提升平台用户的社交粘性，我们在四季度开始推进各微博和产品服务之间，包括超话、个人主页、粉丝群的打通规划。明确微博社交的重点是基于微博主和粉丝之间形成的关系网络和社交行为。保持各社交产品业务目标一致。四季度我们先后加强了超话、内容同关系流，个人主页产品机制的打通，让超话优质内容可以更加高效地触达关系流兴趣用户，促进关系流消费和互动的同时，也能吸引用户在使用超话产品中自然而然地沉淀长尾兴趣社交需求，促进平台社区心智的提升。相关整合工作我们将陆续在2025年上半年完成。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
On social attributes, we have two undertakings on the products. On one hand, we maintain our 2024 strategies for the relationship-based feed by enhancing high quality content consumption, accelerating the construction of vertical content ecosystem, promoting social interaction features, and increasing the social stickiness in the relationship-based feed. In Q4, both the number of interactive users in the relationship feed and interaction rate per thousand views saw a solid year-over-year growth. On the other hand, to further enhance user social stickiness on Weibo, we initiated social product integration plan in Q4 to enhance synergies among Super Topics, My Profile, and Fans Group. To align goals across all social products, product operations, we have clarified that Weibo's social features should focus on the relationship network and social interactions between content creators and fans.
Specifically, in Q4, we focus on product integration of the Super Topics with relationship-based feed and the My Profile, enabling high quality content from Super Topics to naturally and efficiently reach users of interest in the relationship feed. This approach not only boosted content consumption and user interaction in a relationship-based feed, but also encouraged users to engage more organically with Super Topics, fulfilling their long tail interest-based social needs, and reinforcing user recognition of Weibo as a community. We expect to complete this integration plan in the first half of 2025.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
在内容生态方面，四季度重点工作分两部分展开。一方面，我们综合把握热点机会获取用户和流量，同时继续支持对行业垂直的建设投入，支撑商业生态的发展。2024年全年行业垂直的精成立规模、流量、互动人数较去年保持了提升。例如我们紧跟AI局变革，在2024年重点布局AI内容生态建设，打造AI行业热点新闻，形成AI相关话题在平台的热议，同时打造AI领域影响力博主矩阵，推动博主深度参与技术解读和行业洞察。我们还推出一系列AI生产和互动活动，吸引用户参与，让AI更贴近用户。未来在助力行业发展的同时，也能给平台更多的AI相关兴趣用户群带入，逐步形成AI内容生态和商业生态相辅相成的趋势。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
On content ecosystem. In the first quarter, we focused on two areas. First, we seized opportunities in hot trends to acquire users and drive traffic, while continuing to invest in vertical content to reinforce the development of monetization ecosystem. Throughout 2024, we saw significant growth in the scale, traffic, and engagement of the vertical golden and orange verified accounts compared to prior year.
For instance, we kept up with the latest hot trends in advancement of AI technology and prioritized the development of content ecosystem of AI-related vertical. On the one hand, we captured and operated hot trends of the AI industry on Weibo, generating discussion around AI-related hot topics on Weibo. On the other side, we built an ecosystem of KOLs in the AI-related vertical, encouraging them to generate in-depth technology analysis and industry insight content.
Besides, we also launched a series of activities to boost the AI-related content creation and interaction to attract users' participation and to make AI more accessible to them. Looking ahead, our ongoing investment in the AI vertical will not only support the growth of the AI industry, but will also generate more business opportunities in the interest-based user group agencies for the platform, creating a mutually reinforcing relationship between the AI content ecosystem and the monetization ecosystem.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
另一方面，我们在四季度对平台的垂直运营体系做转型尝试。我们垂直内容生态发展核心是基于各垂直头部用户博主生产以及关系流分发体系而展开。但如今，在兴趣内容的推荐消费趋势下，我们的垂直运营管理可能面临挑战，需要尝试博主账号加兴趣内容运营体系的建立。所以四季度我们推出了微博跨域计划，尝试以兴趣点为核心的生产指引，通过驱动垂直头部博主跨领域生产多元兴趣内容，以调动平台内容激励政策，推动更多的博主参与生产，并结合热点推荐分发效率的优化，初步验证了兴趣垂直运营新模式的可行性，也为2025年公司在兴趣推荐体系的建设投入提供了方向。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
In Q4, we started transforming the platform's vertical operating system. Our vertical content ecosystem has been built around the content generation by top creators of all verticals and the distribution system of the relationship-based feed. However, with the shift toward interest-based content consumption, our existing vertical operating and management model has been facing challenges. To address this, we recognize the need to form an integrated model to combine KOL account operation with interest-based content operation. Therefore, we launched the Weibo cross vertical initiative in Q4, aiming to guide content generation around users' interest. The initiative encouraged top vertical KOLs to generate content with diversified interests, adjust the platform's content incentive policy to foster wider participation, and enhance the distribution efficiency of hot topics and recommendation feeds.
These efforts have provided preliminary validation for a new operation model of interest-based vertical content and will guide our investment in the development of the interest-based recommendation mechanism in 2025.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
下面我谈一下四季度的商业化的进展。四季度我们继续聚焦客户新品营销市场，最大化推广微博作为新品营销主阵地的客户心智。虽然四季度微博整体广告收入同比小幅下降，但是关键行业的新品场景下，我们抓紧机会并加强投入，提升客户在新品周期的内容热度和浓度，新品营销收入同比增长双位数。
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
Next, on the monetization front. In Q4, we continued to focus on strengthening clients' perception of Weibo as the primary platform for the new product launch marketing. Despite that Weibo's overall ad revenue in Q4 decreased slightly year-over-year, ad revenue from the new product launch marketing grew by double digits year-over-year. 那我们现在可以看到，在25年肯定我们会加大在AI方面的投入，那之前的一些测试的业务面向全量用户落地的话，现在我们可以比较确定的是搜索有可能会在这个季度会开始全量。那其他的业务可能在未来陆续的几个季度，我们觉得一个是随着更新的模型的投入使用以及成本的下降，我觉得未来几个季度可能也会看到一些不错的进展。Go ahead。
[Translator]
Translator
Also in 2025, we're going to be focusing further and continuously on the investment on AI-related technologies and also topics. For instance, in terms of the full volume realization we've been seeing that this quarter, we're going to realize the full volume of the search capability among all the businesses that are on the testing. Also, second of all, I would like to say that while we are having a further integration of those new models and also the further driving down of the overall cost, this is going to enhance the speed and also accelerate the integration with more capabilities and also AI models.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
搜索方面，2024年其实我们就大家关注的话，已经我们在2024年年中的时候应该已经推出了知搜1.0的版本，那是基于千问大概72B的模型。但是我们也可以看到2025年春节之后，大概我们用两周的时间，就把这个模型系统已经切换到了DeepSeek，那确实是这个产品效果获得了一个明显的提升，而且能够清晰梳理各角度的资讯和细节，那极大地提升了我们这个搜索服务用户的能力。那季对季知搜的MAU大概增长了40%左右。目前热搜的流量和25%的普通的搜索请求里面会展示这个AI结果。那我们预计就是说现在的算力目前还在快速扩展中，应该没有什么太大问题的话，我们会在这个季度去面向全量用户提供服务。那这部分的测试用户群目前已经开了，用户群里面可能互动效率和点击效率都应该都有一个双位数的增长，那对用户的需求的满足度也会有所提升。
[Translator]
Translator
In terms of the intelligent search, we've been seeing that in the last year, especially in the middle of 2024, we've been having the large language models of the Zhisou 1.0 Based on the Qwen model with a parameter of 72 billion. In 2025, after the Chinese New Year, we've been switching to the DeepSeek large language models, and this has further enhanced the capabilities of this particular intelligent search. For instance, the product capability and also with more fine details and all kinds of different angles in asking, in answering those questions.
You can see that in terms of the total number of mMAUs using the intelligent search, this has been increasing by 40% and given us a very good results. You can see that among all the results that have been shown to the public, 25% of those results are based on these intelligent search results and integrating the capability with DeepSeek. With a further enhancement of the computational power, I believe that starting from this year, this quarter, we are going to see the service opening up to the full users, not only those users on the testing scope. This is definitely enhancing the efficiencies of all kinds by double digits.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
我觉得更为重要的是，大模型对于微博以往内容沉淀内容的总结和这种基于逻辑的归纳效果极好，带来了我们搜索能力的一个大幅的提升。那虽然现在我们会看这个线上的AI自搜啊，在前端呈现上还是有非常大的优化空间的，但是我们会看到，就是这个版本已经可以把过去十多年用户产生的微博内容和观点通过大模型来统一地组织和归纳呈现，这还是让微博搜索从一个热点搜索加实时搜索，可以更好地去满足用户的长尾搜索的需求。那么我相信随着目前领先的模型在多模态上的这种完善，包括即将发布的这种新的Qwen的模型的出现，微博这样一个持续不断可以产生优质内容和多元化观点的平台，我们通过这些大模型的助力会发挥出更大的价值。
[Translator]
Translator
Also you can see that is more important for to see that because of this capability of large language models that we're using now, because of its capability to summarize and also help to conclude, all the content that we have been creating and presenting on Weibo platform for the past decades, this is really enhancing the capability of search. For instance, of course there are still rooms for improvement and optimization, in terms of the capability of intelligent search based on AI.
Still, we can see that, those content and also opinions that we have generated on the platform of Weibo during the past more than 10 years, which has been presenting and also organizing our platforms, we can help to summarize and also conclude all these contents. That is going to add up more values to those long tail searches instead of just the searches based on hot trends and also the knowledge based content. Also with further optimizations and also further integration of multiple and diverse models and emergent of new models, we are going to see better content creating and also better presenting of those contents, and also summary of the past years of contents, which is going to add a lot of more values to the users.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
那除了搜索之外呢，已经确定会把这个AI能力开放给全量，那其他的业务就包括商业化呀、互动呀、内容推荐，其实也在加快这部分的实验和逐步的扩量吧。当然商业化方面来看的话呢，在2024年其实让我们的eCPM大概有几个点的小几个点的提升，我预计2025年还能提升，就是小广告还能有类似幅度或者更高的一个提升。那但是因为小广告在我们整体的收入比例目前并不高，所以说对整体的收入，我们看影响还没有那么的大。对，但是品牌广告如何和AI去结合，包括在素材呈现上、个性化素材呈现上，我们也在进行测试。那总之来讲的话呢，我们会看到未来几个季度，我们也希望陆续都可以向大家汇报一些在AI应用方面的成果。谢谢。
[Translator]
Translator
Lastly, I would say that apart from the capability of search, we have been also applying the AI capabilities on the other fronts, for instance, monetization, interactions, and also better recommendations of more content. In terms of monetization, we've been seeing several percentage points of increase in 2024, and I think that this momentum is going to be continuing in 2025, and especially around the area of performance-based ads. Of course, the total ad revenue of those performance-based ads is not that contributive to the overall ad revenue, so this is not impacting the overall ad revenue as a whole in 2025 and also in the future.
Still, we are still actively thinking about the values that we could add to the brand-based ads, especially based on the better and more individualized materials and all the other fronts which are still under testing. We're going to see that how much values we can have for the brand-based ads. Overall speaking, in conclusion that in the next several quarters with the further optimizations and also the applications, we hope that we are able to announce to the public and also investors more progress that we have been making in this front. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Felix Liu from UBS. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Felix Liu
Executive Director, UBS
谢谢管理层接受我的提问，也恭喜公司2024年稳健的利润，考虑到收入承压的这个背景下。那我的问题是关于公司2025年广告业务的展望，考虑到九月以来，经济刺激政策不断落地，公司对2025年的宏观和消费趋势有怎样的观察？以及公司对2025年广告行业的表现有怎样的预期？除了宏观以外呢，我另外一部分也是想了解一下公司对2025年广告业务的市场竞争力提高有怎样的策略和布局。好，谢谢。
Let me translate myself. Thank you management for taking my question, and congratulations on the resilient bottom line despite the slight revenue decline in 2024. My question is on the 2025 outlook for advertisement. Considering the economic policy stimulus since September last year, how does management see the macro and consumption trends in 2025? What's management's expectation on your ad performance by industry vertical in 2025? Last but not least, what are your strategies to improve the competitiveness of your advertisement business in 2025? Thank you.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
谢谢。我们看，尽管四季度以来，国家推出了多项逆周期的政策，包括国补这些，但是目前看，除了汽车、手机和电商之外，还没有全面传导至更多的行业。毫无疑问，国补政策对于3C数码和电商这两个行业在四季度的增长起到了立竿见影的效果。但是我们也会看到，像美妆、食品这些没有国补，跟大部分的非必需品的消费，在去年的下半年还是继续承压的。另外来讲的话，对整体宏观经济，我们会看到后面的行业客户的展望来讲，确实需要时间来判断。广告市场我们也会看到2025年的预算投入，大部分行业，除了明确有国补的行业之外，还存在着谨慎和观望的态度。
[Translator]
Translator
Thanks for this question. After Q4, we've seen a lot of implementations of the policies by the national government, and especially around the area of national subsidies, for instance. This is impacting immediately on the verticals like automotives, handsets, and e-commerce. Still, for those other industries that are not enjoying this particular national subsidy policies, we're not seeing a very good progress made. In terms of the national subsidy policy, this has been impacting immediately positively on the 3C products and e-commerce industry. We've been seeing a very good growth of the ad revenue from these areas in Q4. However, in the other areas, they are not enjoying this kind of policy.
For instance, the beauty and personal care products and luxury, and also the other discretionary industries will be seeing a lot of pressures and also stress of growth. Of course that, and you know, in the near future still we have to remain precautious on these areas, especially without those favorable national policies, especially around the budget allocated by the customers in 2025. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
如果分行业来看的话，毫无疑问，电商行业我们会看到今年也有比较确定性的一个，特别是对于一些领先的平台，像品牌性比较强的品牌，像阿里、京东，应该是有一些比较确定性的增长。那相对来讲的话，他们在微博的这种营销和广告投入我们也比较有信心。那手机跟汽车来看的话，这两个行业从微博的内容生态、热点生态的结合，过去几年一直做的是不错的，那汽车行业竞争可能依旧比较激烈，那包括厂商的价格补贴也可能会继续持续。但是基于微博内容营销的差异化的竞争力，我们认为目前看，我们整个这个行业的抗风险能力也比较高。虽然燃油车依旧处于这个下滑的趋势，但是整体来讲，新能源的增长应该能够抵消燃油车预算下滑的缺口。
[Translator]
Translator
Okay, also second of all, you know, from the other verticals, for instance, in e-commerce, especially among those top platforms like Alibaba and JD.com, definitely speaking, there could be a very affirmative and also confirmative growth in this year in 2025. In the other two verticals, handsets and also automotives, we've been seeing a very good integration into the content ecosystem of Weibo. Of course, it's very highly competitive for the automotive industry. Also still we're going to see a lot of subsidies implemented by the OEMs. This is going to be very much a beneficial industry. Of course, because of the capability of a differentiated competitive strength of Weibo and also very good anti-stress capability of Weibo as a platform, we're going to see a very good growth in this area.
Of course, that we've been seeing a trend of decrease for the ICE vehicle, but still this is going to be offset by the growth of the new energy vehicle sector. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
得益于我们去年在效果广告上还有提到AI的投入，因为eCPM和CTR都有一定的提升，我们的互联网APP类下载这个客户呢，在2024年也是保持了一个不错的增长，我们预期2025年应该也是可以保持这个趋势。但是来讲，我觉得2025年最不确定的一个行业可能就是游戏，因为2023年来讲的话呢，游戏不管是在年中，其实每一个季度，每一两个季度都有比较大的游戏，就是头部游戏的这种出现。但是2024年全年，其实手机游戏这边其实并没有特别能够支撑市场一个预算或者一个增量的空间。虽然说有一些中型的游戏进行了一些投放，那目前我们从客户的pipeline上来看的话呢，2025年其实对于游戏的大型游戏的这种投放其实也是不太乐观的。所以说我觉得2025年其实游戏的行业可能会不太确定。
[Translator]
Translator
Also, just now we've been sharing some of the colors on our investments on the AI capabilities for the performance-based ads, and this has been given us very good results by improving the eCPM and also the other parameters. We've been seeing a very good growth of the other customers, for instance, that are focusing on the app downloading, for instance. This was good. In 2025, the only industry I believe that is not certain, that is uncertain, for instance, is the gaming industry. You know that since 2023, every year at the end of each year, we're going to see a very good publishing and also announcements of new large games every 1 or 2 quarters. This trend has stopped in 2024.
Throughout the whole year of 2024, we did not see a lot of announcements and also launch of the large mobile games and big mobile games. Although we've been seeing some of the announcements and launches of the medium-scale games, but still there are lack of a big blockbuster games launched throughout the whole year of 2024. Commenting on the pipelines of our customers in 2025, we are not that optimistic in seeing a lot of large and blockbuster games launched throughout the year. The gaming industry is the most uncertain industry in this front in 2025.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
所以跟我刚才说的延续啊，我们对二五年整体预估呢，还是比较谨慎的，因为不同行业其实差异还是从目前摸底的情况看，差异还是比较大的，我们会继续持续观察二五年上半年政策窗口的情况。我们期待随着这种更多的政策出台，以及这些政策的逐步落地，可以对宏观经济消费和相关行业带来明显的积极促进作用。那在需求端不确定性的情况下呢，我们重心还是放在供给端的策略调整和我们广告产品策略的优化上。比如加强AI在这些商业化的领域的应用，提升我们这个商业化的这种效率。那具体到我们客户服务上呢，会致力于抓住客户的新品，那重大节点、重大热点的营销需求，不断去深化微博在内容营销和新品营销上的核心优势，提升我们的市场竞争力。
[Translator]
Translator
Also in 2025, throughout the whole year, we have to be really cautious on this front. Of course that's because different industries, as I have already stated, had all kinds of different performance and also different level of the pressure or optimistic growth. What we have to do is that in 2025, we have to pay close attention to the implementation of the government's policies throughout the first half of 2025, and further to see that whether that is going to be further impacting the macro economy and also the overall consumption of China. Of course, that was not ideal in the area of demand side.
We have to be really, you know, doing something to actively change our supply side strategies, and also the overall strategy of our company. For instance, as I have already stated, we have emphasized more on the investments on AI capabilities, and the integration of AI capabilities can further help us to improve the efficiency of monetization. Also we have to see the trend of our customers, when they are launching new products and also emphasizing more budgets on the marketing when they're doing so that we are able to, you know, do more and better in the ad business and also further enhance the competitive edges of Weibo in this area.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo Corporation
整体策略来看的话，其实我们的内容运营策略和我们的商业运营策略其实是一致的。比如说我们从疫情之后，其实跟大家讲的一直都是我们重点要做的其实就是做垂直化，因为我们在疫情期间我们的新闻流量占比其实是过高的，我们用大概几年的时间需要把我们原来的这种垂直化内容、行业化内容的占比尽量提上去。那现在在整体的平台里面，其实垂直内容的力量已经恢复到将近50%，但是还是有比较高的一个提升空间的。那我们相信就是对于整个大盘里面垂直化流量，它其实是比新闻性的流量，它的商业化的价值和它的变现价值，以及它的用户粘性都要高很多的。就像我们刚才提到的，它900亿的《Nezha 2》电影的流量和200亿的DeepSeek的流量，是要远比一些社会新闻流量，它的变现价值和用户的信任价值都会更高。那这个其实不管外部行业怎么变化，我们还是要打好这个基础，这也对于各个行业未来的变现其实会打好我们不管是在内容生态还是商业生态方面的基础。这也是整体来讲我们25年的重心的策略。谢谢。
[Translator]
Translator
Also last but not least, I have to say that the strategies of our content operation is exactly the same as the strategies of the operation of our monetization. As I have already stated, after COVID-19, what we have to do is that emphasize more on the traffic growth of the vertical related traffics, because you know that during the COVID period, most of our traffics are related to news.
That has taken a larger proportion of the overall traffic allocated there during COVID. After the COVID, we have to reallocate the traffic and also emphasize on different strategies. After COVID and as of now, we've been recovering to almost 50% of the original level before COVID in terms of the traffic of the other vertical related content, but still there are rooms for further improvements. Therefore you can see that, for those vertical related content in terms of the capabilities of monetization and also the capabilities of the user stickiness, it is way much better than the other traffics.
For instance, the 90 billion traffic for Nezha 2 and 20 billion traffic for the DeepSeek top related topics, these traffics have better capabilities of monetization. While we are grasping these opportunities, this is going to help us to further consolidate our strength and also set up a better foundation for the capabilities of monetization in the future. This is what we have to do in 2025 specifically. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now go to our next question. Please stand by. The next question comes from the line of Daisy Chen from Haitong International. Please go ahead. Your line is now open.
Daisy Chen
Research Analyst, Haitong International
管理层晚上好，感谢接受我的提问。我看我们这个季度还是宣布了两亿美元的股息。我想说在去年广告行业比较困难的情况下，我们还保持了这个股息的发放频率以及相应的规模，真的是一个非常值得敬佩的行为。那我问题是可不可以请管理层跟我们分享更多关于股东回报的信息，比如说未来的这个计划和方式，比如除了股息之外，会不会有股票回购等等。谢谢。
Weibo has announced a $200 million dividend. It's very delightful that the company still mentioned the same size and frequency, even under such difficult environment for the online ads business last year. We really respect that. Can management share more color on shareholder return policy, such as the future plan and the method? Maybe do you want to consider share repurchases. Thank you.
Fei Cao
CFO, Weibo Corporation
Thank you, Daisy Chen. This is Fei Cao. I will take your question. Weibo is focused on a balanced capital allocation strategy that supports long-term growth while delivering value to our shareholders. As you mentioned, over the past three years, our net income operating margin has remained stable, and our operating cash flow reached around $600 million, giving us the flexibility to invest in AI, in product innovation, and shareholder returns. We pay dividends, as you mentioned. Our capital allocation follows some key principles. Mainly two key principles. First, driving business growth and staying competitive. AI is playing an increasingly important role in enhancing our product experience, as Gaofei Wang mentioned in his remarks, in Weibo's search, and we are actively expanding its applications in social and ad products.
We remain committed to investing in AI while maintaining a disciplined financial approach to ensure our long-term stability and a profit margin that remains competitive within the industry. Second, enhancing shareholder returns. As you have seen from our announcement, our board approved an annual dividend policy providing more predictable returns based on our financial performance and capital needs. This reflects our commitment to delivering sustainable shareholder value while maintaining the flexibility to invest in long-term growth opportunities. We are open to other methods, such as buyback. Going forward, we will continue to refine our capital allocation strategy, leverage AI to strengthen our product capabilities, and create long-term value for our shareholders. Hope this answers your question. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now conclude the Q&A session, and I would like to hand back to Sandra Zhang for any closing remarks.
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations Representative, Weibo Corporation
Thank you, operator, and thank you all for joining our conference call today. This wraps up our call. We'll see you next time.
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, this concludes today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect.

content.text:
Operator
This time all participants are in a listen only mode. After the speaker's presentation, there will be a question and answer session. To ask a question during the session, you will need to press star 1 1 on your telephone. You will then hear an automated message advising your hand is raised. To withdraw your question, please press star 1 and 1 again.
Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded. I would now like to hand the conference over to your speaker today, Sandra Zhang. Please go ahead.
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Thank you, operator. Welcome to Weibo's Q2 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our Chief Executive Officer, Gaofei Wang, and our Chief Financial Officer, Fei Cao. This conference call is also being broadcast on the Internet and is available through Weibo's IR website.
Before the management remarks, I would like to read you the safe harbour statement in connection with today's conference call. During today's conference call, we may make forward-looking statements that are not historical facts, including statements of our beliefs and expectations. Forward-looking statements involve inherent risks and uncertainties.
A number of important factors could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statement. Weibo assumes no obligation to update a forward-looking statement in this conference call and elsewhere.
Further information regarding this and other risks is included in Weibo's annual report on Form 20-F and other filings with the SEC. All the information provided in this press release is accurate as of the date hereof. Weibo assumes no obligation to update such information except as required under applicable law. Additionally, I would like to remind you that our discussion today includes certain non-GAAP measures, which exclude stock-based compensation and certain other expenses.
We use non-GAAP financial measures to gain a better understanding of Weibo's comparative operating performance and the future prospects. Our non-GAAP financials exclude certain expenses, gains orlosses, and other items that are not expected to result in future cash payments or are non-recurring in nature, or are not indicative of our core operating results and outlook. Please refer to our press release for more information about our non-GAAP measures.
Following management prepared remarks, we will open the lines for a brief Q&A session. With this, I would like to turn the call over to our CEO, Gaofei Wang. Thank you. Hello, everyone. Welcome to Weibo's Earnings Conference Call.
Today, I will share with you highlights in Weibo's product monetization in Q2 2024. On the user front, by the end of Q2, Weibo's MAU reached 583 million, and average DAUs reached 256 million. In light of an already sizable user community and a mature user mindset, we have proactively adjusted our user strategy this year, with more channel budget allocated to the acquisition and engagement of the high-quality users.
This quarter, our DAU versus MAU ratios increased year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter, reflecting further improvement of user engagement.
On the monetization front, in the past 2 years, we have been focusing on combining Weibo's hot trend products with advertising's marketing demand, and thus our hot trend marketing has been recognized by a wider range of industries and advertisers.
In Q2, our total revenues reached $437.9 million, of which our ad revenues reached $375.3 million. On a constant currency basis, our total revenue would have increased 1% year-over-year, and our ad revenues would have decreased 1% year-over-year. Our non-GAAP operating income reached $157.6 million, representing a non-GAAP operating margin of 36%, a modest pickup year-over-year. Next, let me share with you progress made in product and monetization in Q2.
In 2024, we still focus on growing user scale and engagement, strengthening the competitiveness of content ecosystem, and improving operating efficiency as our key strategic objectives.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
On the channel front, we maintain close cooperation with handset manufacturers focusing on the acquisition of high value users and promotion of user engagement. We also invested to further refine accuracy of algorithms and targeting capability of our business model in order to create enriched content offerings for our channel users and increase their user engagement, which laid the foundation for monetization.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
On social attributes in Q2, while leveraging our relationship-based feed to further recover vertical content ecosystem. We strengthen the interaction between KOLs and fans, increase their user stickiness, and improve user interaction efficiency of relationship-based feed.
Meanwhile, this year we have also been investing in user generated content by improving the growth path of high quality UGC in Weibo to encourage more quality content generation around vertical content and boost user engagement. In terms of user interest sharing, we further strengthen Super Topic community as a core domain for users to share interest related content.
In the H1 of this year, user social interaction increased significantly with double-digit growth year-over-year. For example, during the H1 of this year, we increase the interaction between celebrity and fans by expanding campaigns of celebrity and their works.
As a result, in Q2, the number of average daily users who posted and the number of posts in the entertainment-related super topics increased over 50% year-over-year, respectively. In terms of the daily life sharing content by ordinary users, we improve the distribution mechanism for those high-quality content to be fairly distributed in core feeds and help users who consistently generate content to accumulate fan base.
For instance, in Q2, we launched a Weibo photography campaign to select high-quality UGC photography around daily life, aiming to encourage all users to record and share their daily life in multiple dimensions. During the first campaign in May and June, nearly 500,000 users shared their photography and contributed over 2.1 million photographs, attracting over 3 million users to engage and interact.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
On the content ecosystem front. In Q2, while maintaining our competitiveness in the IP-related content ecosystem of hot trends, entertainment, and events, we focused on increasing investment in verticals such as digital products, automotive, game, fashion and beauty, and healthcare to enhance Weibo's competitiveness in the content ecosystem and further improve monetization efficiency.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
In Q2, with the release of new entertainment works, we leverage our advantage of our entertainment works as well as fans' interactions across verticals. We encourage more users to consume and discuss around entertainment content.
As a result, the number of user interactions in the entertainment vertical increased double-digit year-over-year. For example, in Q2, we reached in-depth cooperation with the music variety show Singer 2024 of Hunan TV station on cross-screen live streaming and real-time hot topics to achieve user interactions.
The show became a phenomenal hit in the H1 of 2024 through launching innovative campaigns on Weibo, such as allowing users to recommend singer across platforms, start candidate posts on Weibo, and roll out real-time hot trends around the show.
The total views of the show, Singer 2024, exceeded 60 billion times, and the number of user interaction discussions exceeded 560 million times. This hot-trend-plus-social-interaction pattern between TV and social media not only makes the show influential, but also provide brand advertisers with more diversified marketing solutions and generated sustainable ad revenue growth for Weibo through hot trend marketing.
During college entrance exam season this year, we cooperated with People's Daily to boost discussion on university's major selection and application after the entrance exam and organized experts and KOLs of over ten verticals such as education, healthcare, digital products, automotive, and finance to share with examinees on suggestions of professional learning, application, and industry employment.
The total views of college entrance exam related content reached 38.9 billion times in June, and the number of user discussions exceeded 110 million times, representing an increase of over 50% compared with the same period last year.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
We continue to focus on 2 aspects in Q2. First, we strengthen the construction of vertical content ecosystem, including supporting vertical content and engaging cross field accounts and media outlet in the generation and distribution of vertical hot trends.
Second, we beef up the support of golden and orange verified accounts in vertical areas and empower them to earn higher commercial returns on our platform. In Q2, we continue to reinforce hot trend operation in automotive and digital product verticals, with emphasis on industry, brand, and product. As a result, the number of golden verified accounts in automotive and digital product verticals, as well as their traffic, interaction, and ad revenue on our platform, continued to increase year-over-year.
For example, for the automotive vertical, as competition in the new energy vehicle market intensified, OEMs step up their investment in content operation. In the H1 of this year, over 30 manufacturers and around 100 executives of auto industry registered or activated Weibo accounts. Thanks to the content contribution from these executives, KOLs, and media accounts in the automotive industry also actively created follow up hot topics.
We are pleased to see our clients join us in building the automotive content ecosystem, which not only help clients refine brand operation and product promotion, but also lay the foundation for our long term business cooperation with clients.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
As for the online game vertical, built upon content construction of online game ecosystem over the past 3 years, we have covered over 80% of the top 100 games in terms of content operation. UGC creation and interaction thickness continue to improve, leading to rapid growth of the Golden verified accounts in the online game vertical.
In Q2, the number of Golden verified accounts in this vertical increased by over 80% year-over-year, with their traffic and interaction grew over 30% on an annual basis. Leveraging Weibo's expanded advantages in the online gaming ecosystem and higher influence of Golden verified accounts, we have built closer partnership with online game clients on content marketing.
In Q2, nearly 50% of the commercial projects for game promotion chose to cooperate with Weibo in hot trend marketing, demonstrating better recognition of Weibo's Golden verified accounts among clients in this industry.
The ad revenue of Golden verified accounts from the game industry increased by over 4 times year-over-year. We are delighted to see that the online game vertical has gradually entered the self-reinforcing cycles between content and monetization ecosystem, similar to the automotive and digital vertical.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Moving on to monetization. In 2024, we will continue to beef up our efforts to reinforce our monetization competitiveness, leveraging Weibo's strength in hot trend and IPs, as well as thriving vertical content ecosystem. We will sharpen the competitive edge of our content marketing and performance ad product in the hope of enhancing our capabilities to navigate through business risk in key industries.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Amid a relatively soft ad market in Q2, our ad revenue decreased 1% year-over-year on a constant currency basis. By industry, our advantageous industries such as handset and automotive industries sustained solid growth trends, benefiting from clients' recognition of Weibo's hot trend marketing. Therefore, our ad wallet share of clients' marketing budget in this sector either remained stable or increased.
Thanks to the impressive topic views and discussion generated by the blockbuster IPs such as Singer 2024, Weibo attracted many clients to launch campaigns around these IP related hot trends, which brought forth incremental hot trend marketing dollars to our platform. For example, in Q2, vivo and Weibo reached a strategic cooperation in content marketing, achieving in-depth co-creation of content between Weibo platform and the brand.
To elaborate, we expanded marketing initiative on new product launch through daily hot trends throughout the year, and thus comprehensively enhanced the user reach and nurtured user mindshare of the brand and its product.
Take the vivo X100 series launched in Q2 as an example. After the new product release in May, vivo took advantage of the peak period of offline concert in Q2, and the popularity of variety show Singer 2024 actively participated in the co-creation of hot trends and strengthened user awareness of the differentiated tech of the vivo X100 series concert go-getter to enhance user penetration of vivo's portrait photography.
We successfully helped vivo achieve the first place in the dual track of concerts and telephoto. In the current internet IP market, clients will gradually concentrate on the top IPs.
This trend can also be seen from the traffic structure of Weibo. The traffic and monetization opportunities brought forth by the top IPs was significantly higher than those from mid-tier IPs. On the flip side, in Q2, the sales of international cosmetic brands were still under pressure, which negatively affected the pace of new product launch and thus their scalable budgets.
Therefore, our ad revenue from the cosmetic and beauty sector continued on a descending trajectory year-over-year. In order to boost clients' willingness of new product marketing and its effectiveness, we step up our cooperation with e-commerce platforms and domestic brands this year.
To elaborate, we actively explore the synergy of new product launch of the FMCG industry between social and e-commerce platforms, and provide clients with better marketing support.
We hope these efforts could translate into more stable growth in the FMCG sector in the coming quarters. In Q2, we started the cooperation on new product launch marketing with Tmall, which focused on the cosmetics and beauty, as well as footwear and apparel industries.
Leveraging Weibo's strength in hot trend marketing, we offer full funnel value proposition to clients from social influence to e-commerce conversion. With this partnership, we hope to enhance clients' recognition of the value of Weibo's culture marketing, and also cultivate and reinforce users' mindset of discovering new product on Weibo.
We will continue to explore this model with Tmall in Q3 and try to penetrate into more industries and clients.
With higher client recognition of Weibo's cultural marketing and a broadening coverage of domestic beauty brands, we hope to see our ad revenue in the cosmetic and beauty sector stabilize or return to growth year-over-year in Q4.
Overall speaking, amid the current competitive landscape, based on the current brand plus performance ad offerings, Weibo's marketing service has upgraded to content marketing solutions with emphasis on hot trend and IP, celebrity and KOL, and plus performance ad. Leveraging adjustment in the sales structure and ad product in the past 2 years, the market competitiveness of these 3 types of ad offerings has gradually improved and become the key driver of revenue.
Ad revenue directly generated by these 3 types of offerings account for over 50% of our total ad revenues. From industry perspective, the hot trend and IP marketing primarily serves the FMCG, digital product, and automotive industries.
Clients in these industries seek to amplify their product influence, leveraging organic hot trends, or even build market hype around their new products through Weibo's hot trend marketing. The celebrity and KOL marketing mainly caters to the luxury goods, cosmetics, and beauty, as well as footwear and apparel industries.
Clients can better reach fans and influence their consumption decision with higher accuracy by working with celebrities and KOLs in professional areas. Finally, despite the fierce competition in the performance marketing in recent years, we are gradually improving our ad competitiveness through algorithm optimization and social native ad offerings.
Although performance ad has now become the main contributor to revenue growth in the past 2 years, performance ad offerings are crucial for us to broaden client coverage and identify high quality clients. In contrast to other platforms' competitive edge in traffic-based monetization, we have built our competitiveness on media-oriented and brand-oriented ad placement, as well as content marketing based on hot trend IPs and celebrities.
These differentiations are critical for us to obtain marketing budget for product promotion and user mindset. Meanwhile, as we further strengthen the construction of content ecosystem in the entertainment, sports event, and industry-based verticals, and better integrate organic content ecosystem with commercial content ecosystem, our business model, which is mainly based on brand plus celebrity marketing and content marketing, well supplemented by performance ads, will be more conducive to improving the platform's monetization efficiency.
This is also our most important strategy and objective for strengthening our monetization competitiveness in future. With that, let me turn the call over to Fei Cao for a financial review.
Fei Cao
CFO, Weibo
Thank you, Gaofei, and hello, everyone. Welcome to Weibo's Q2 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Let's start with user metrics. In June 2024, Weibo's MAUs reached 583 million, and average DAUs reached 256 million.
As communicated last quarter, in 2024, we have proactively adjusted our user strategy to put more emphasis on the acquisition and engagement of high-quality users, as demonstrated by improved DAU versus MAU ratio this quarter.
Turning to financials. As a reminder, my prepared remarks would focus on non-GAAP results. All monetary amounts are in US dollar terms, and all comparisons are on a year-on-year basis, unless otherwise noted. Now, let me walk you through our financial highlights for the Q2 2024.
Weibo's Q2 2024 net revenue was $437.9 million, a decrease of 1%, or an increase of 1% on a constant currency basis. Operating income was $157.6 million, representing an operating margin of 36%. Net income attributable to Weibo reached $176.3 million, representing a net margin of 29%.
Diluted EPS was $0.48. Let me give you more color on the Q2 2024 revenue performance. Weibo's advertising and marketing revenues for the Q2 2024 were $375.3 million, a decrease of 3% or 1% on a constant currency basis, reflecting muted ad demand amidst tapered macro environment. Mobile ad revenues was $352.3 million, contributing approximately 94% of total ad revenues.
In terms of growth, 3C products, e-commerce, and entertainment were the largest contributors to growth. We are delighted to see sustained ad revenue increase in the 3C sector this quarter, leveraging a robust content ecosystem and a dynamic discussion tab around 3C products.
The entertainment sector demonstrated good momentum this quarter, driven by blockbuster TV programs and Weibo's unique value proposition for hot trends. On the flip side, the top line recovery was still dragged by underperformance of the FMCG sector.
Despite a modest growth of the food, beverage, and apparel sectors, the cosmetic and personal care sector still feels behind due to large ad budgets from MNCs and the intense competition among ad platforms. In ad products, promoted feed ads was the largest, followed by social display, topics, and search.
Ad revenues from Alibaba for Q2 was CNY 32.4 million, an increase of 31% or 23% on constant currency basis. We are pleased to see the solid ad growth from Alibaba continue throughout the H1 of 2024 as Weibo's brand plus performance solution resonated well with Alibaba to fulfill its first funnel marketing goals.
Before turning to VAST segment, let me share some preliminary color on the trend entering Q3 2024. On the app side, Weibo continues to be the go-to platform to discover and discuss around hot trends during the Summer Olympics, which boosted user engagement and attracted intensive ad placement. That said, with a chunk of advertising budget allocated to the Olympic Games, we expect relatively lukewarm ad demand post the Olympic season, tracking in sluggish consumption data.
We will beef up our sales execution and enrich Weibo's content ecosystem in the H2 of the year in the hope of mitigating macro and industry headwinds. Turning to VAST. VAST revenues was CNY 62.6 million in Q2, an increase of 15% or 18% on a constant currency basis, primarily driven by revenue growth of membership services.
We have benefited from improved ARPU for membership services since we rolled out premium SVIP features to cater to the needs of BT users. Turning to costs and expenses. Total costs and expenses for Q2 were CNY 218.3 million, a decrease of 2%. Operating income in Q2 was CNY 157.6 million, representing an operating margin of 36%, compared to 35% in the same period last year. Turning to income tax.
Under GAAP measure, income tax expense for Q2 was $33.3 million, compared to $25.5 million last year. The increase was mainly due to the withholding tax accrued related to earnings to be re-remitted from our WFOE to our Hong Kong subsidiary, which is to fund our demand for US dollars in business operations and the payment of dividends and debt, et cetera, in future.
Net income attributable to Weibo's shareholders in Q2 was $126.3 million, sluggish year-over-year. Net margin was 29%, sluggish versus the same period last year. Turning to our balance sheet and cash flow item as of June 30, 2024. Weibo's cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $2.84 billion.
We have made a special cash dividend payment of approximately $199.4 million in May. In Q2, cash provided by operating activities was $132.1 million. Capital expenditures totaled $10.3 million, and depreciation and amortization expenses amounted to $14.5 million. With that, let me now turn the call over to the operator for the Q&A session.
Operator
Thank you. As a reminder, to ask a question, please press star 1 1 on your telephone and wait for your name to be announced. To withdraw your question, please press star 1 1 again. We will now take the first question. From the line of Alicia Yap from Citigroup. Please go ahead.
Alicia Yap
Analyst, Citigroup
Hello. Thank you. Thanks management for taking my questions. Can management comment a little bit how you view the overall macro outlook, and how will that, you know, translate to your advertising outlook for the H2 of this year?
Then can you share with us whether you have observed any meaningful change of the advertiser sentiment in the different industry vertical? Any particular shift of the sentiment from any advertiser that you might have observed? Does management believe the current macro environment could actually last into next year? Thank you.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Thank you very much for the question. First of all, in terms of advertisement revenue in Q2 from RMB standpoint, this was flat versus the last quarter and also year-on-year wise. You can see that although we've been experiencing some of the decline and also the decrease of the overall consumption, but still the willingness of placing the ads with us from the advertisers was pretty much stable.
In terms of the overall revenue in Q2, we can see that there was a pretty significantly negative impact by the verticals like the cosmetics and beauty products by about 5%. For the rest of the other industries, we're experiencing a pretty much growth. OK.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Also in terms of the Q3 outlook and also the H2 performance, there are still some of the uncertainties in terms of the macro economy development, especially about the consumption. We remain very much cautious over the outlook for the rest of 2024.
Still we will be experiencing some of the challenges in terms of the resumption of the consumption and the macro economy in the first-tier cities, for instance. This is of course going to impact some of the willingness of placing the ads by the advertisers.
Still you can see that against the other, you know, players in this advertising industry, Weibo's advertising business is relatively not that big. Still we are seeing some of the cautious behaviors of the placing ads by the advertisers.
Still in terms of the new products launch and some of the other relevant advertisements related to the new products, the customers are tending to choose those top-notch IP and also top-notch platforms to do their advertisements and also promotion. This is going to help us to acquire additional budget from this standpoint. OK.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Furthermore, we can see that we are able to divide the customers into 3 categories or 3 kinds. The first category is in the FMCG industry, including the food and beverages, the apparels and shoes, as well as the entertainment industries.
Still the scale of the consumption or the volume in total is pretty large. Even if the customers are pretty much cautious in allocating their budgets for development, but still they are quite intentional in searching for new IP and also concentrate on those top-notch platforms.
For instance, in Q3, we had the big activities like the Olympic Games, and you can see that in terms of the hot trend selling rate and also the other parameters, we are seeing a very good improvement and also the boost. Meaning that the customers are willing to spend budget on acquiring those top-notch IPs and also collaborating with the top-notch platform. From this standpoint, Weibo still stands in terms of our advantages. OK.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
For the other industries and verticals, for instance, the handsets, automotives, and gaming, as well as the films, movies, and those entertainment industries, for instance, we were experiencing pretty much pressure and stress over the consumption improvement and resumption. Still, most of the competitions are pretty much around the new products and some of the new movie marketing, for instance, and also promotion.
People, and also different companies are competing with the, with each other to get more market share around the marketing for new products and new launches. Weibo still holds our advantage in this particular area, in terms of, hot, you know, social topics as well as the very good relationship with some of the, customers.
In that sense, for instance, in this summer holiday, the box office of most of the new movies, you know, slowed down or decreased a lot year-on-year wise compared with the same period last year, almost happened in terms of the total value of the box office.
Still, because of a very good relationship and our customers are choosing Weibo to promote their new products and also increasing their budget on us. From this standpoint, we are still increasing our revenue and we do have our advantage in this area. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
For the third category, we're talking about those stressed industries. For instance, the cosmetics and beauty products, and also some of the luxury brands. We've been seeing a very stressed situation over the resumption and increase of the consumption as a whole. In these particular industries, the customers are not choosing to launch any new products and in order to get better results.
As a result, we've been seeing most of the ads were pretty much the performance-based ads or some of the discounts and promotional activities or campaigns. Weibo is less competitive in this front. Of course, we can still gain our revenue by getting the budget of the performance-based ads from our customers or organizing some of the campaigns for our customers.
Still, Weibo is less competitive versus the previous 2 categories and also the marketing methods in this arena. Okay
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Well, thank you.
Operator
Thank you. We will now take the next question from the line of Xueqing Zhang from CICC. Please go ahead.
Xueqing Zhang
Analyst, CICC
Thanks, management, for taking my question. My question is regarding AIGC. We notice that the company's self-developed Zhiwei large language model successfully passed the registration in July. What's our latest development in AIGC? How does it help our content production and commercialization efficiency? Thank you.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Thank you for this question. First of all, previously we've shared with everybody about the application of AIGC by Weibo, and the standpoint of generating content for the platform and also enhancing the interaction between the users and among users. In the H2 or later stage of July, you know, we were hearing about the approval of the LLM that developed by Weibo and by the government.
We use this technology to further boost and also enhance the AI products that we are applying now. For instance, you know, comment robots and also some of the AI assistants in getting the response to the users. We hope that the interaction based on the content by Weibo on a Weibo platform is going to be more intelligent and also timely fashion. Okay.
Gaofei Wang
CEO, Weibo
[Foreign Language]
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Okay. Also the second thing that I'd like to say is that you know in Q2, we've been or in the H1 of this year, also we had a you know better interpretation and understanding capability by this AI model, especially the multimodal understanding and also interpretation of the contents on Weibo.
Because we know that there are millions of billions of contents generated by the random users, and also because these contents were randomly generated by the users, it was not standardized and it was not you know structured, and also it was not that common, I mean following certain pattern in terms of the total user.
Also those contents were having the image form, the video, and also text. At the current stage, the recommendation of those contents to the relevant target users is still based on the correct and precise interpretation and understanding of those contents. At the current stage, the large language models that we have got approval is primarily used in this front to better understand and also more precisely understand and interpret the message and content in order to have a more precise recommendation to the users. Now we have a coverage of almost 90% of the users.
Of course still there are some of the works that we need to further working on in order to improve the precisions of the understanding. We need to do some of the further efforts to increase the computational power in this area as well. Still we are observing the future potential of this particular feature. Second point I'd like to say is that, you know, in now in terms of the searching results, there are some of the results that from the media or we media or from the random users.
This particular AI is able to help the users within 1 minute to conclude and summarize the searched contents, so that the user experience is going to be much better in using the search feature of Weibo. Because of this, in Q2, we had already MAU of this particular feature exceeding 10 million already. This is only 1 of the examples that we are trying the capability of AI.
In the near future, we are going to have a better trial of this in helping us to better interpret and understanding the contents, and also to trigger and based on the information based flow that we have, and also based on the other capabilities that we have, we are going to have a better use and application of the AI feature and also this technology. Okay.
Operator
Thank you. There are no further questions at this time. I would like to hand over to Sandra Zhang for closing remarks.
Sandra Zhang
Investor Relations, Weibo
Thanks, operator, and thank you all for joining our conference call today. We'll see you next quarter.
Operator
This concludes today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect.
